description: Residential air handling units with the built-in Modbus interface: temperatures, fan speeds and feedback, pressures, humidity and air quality, ventilation mode and setpoints, heating and cooling outputs, alarms and filter time
source: Flexit, Nordic Modbus register list (Flexit GO, built-in Modbus)
notes: Addresses are those of the list, which it calls base 0: 3x0001 is input register 1 on the wire. Input registers are read with function 04, holding registers with 03 and written with 06 or 16.
Values are big endian; 32-bit floats are taken as high word first (the list states the byte order only).
Many registers exist only when the matching function is configured; their entries say which.
Writable registers are only accessible while System Status (4x9001) is Operation mode.
Written from the manufacturer's register list; not tested on a device.
